## Editor's Brief

The past 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic escalation in the Middle East, with Iran launching ballistic missiles at Israel for the first time since the April ceasefire, triggering Israeli retaliatory strikes and a US military response against Iranian coastal radar sites.
